description: KPI by Powerviz is a powerful custom visual for Power BI that allows users to visualize and create eye-catching and advanced Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). It contains 16 different layers and over 40 different chart variations that you can create. Using advanced text editor and on-object layer you can create pixel perfect designed visuals in your next report. The best part about KPI is no prior learning is required. This add-on provided all the key features you need to create a fully dynamic KPI and sparklines. Design features Rich customization and formatting options 16 Different layers to create your KPI Designs. Offers shapes, images, and icons to create infographic designs. Pixel-perfect positioning of layers and responsive design Users can create KPI Objects in layers combining charts, metrics, and icons. Full control over positioning and overlap allows for pixel-perfect design. Powerviz KPI allows users to configure color and style. Analytical Features Orientation Options: KPIs can be displayed in both vertical and horizontal orientations. Data Visualization Types: Categorical: Compare values across distinct categories. Comparison: Analyze differences between data points. Composition: Show parts of a whole (e.g. market share). Progression: Display trends over time.
